scripts.build: xcodebuild build -project Neram.xcodeproj -scheme Neram -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile -destination generic/platform=iOS -destination platform=macOS,arch=arm64 CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet
scripts.format: xcrun swift-format format --in-place --recursive Neram NeramKit/Sources NeramKit/Tests NeramUITests
scripts.lint: xcrun swift-format lint --strict --recursive Neram NeramKit/Sources NeramKit/Tests NeramUITests
scripts.test: swift test --package-path NeramKit && xcodebuild test -project Neram.xcodeproj -scheme Neram -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=${IOS_SIMULATOR:-iPhone 17}" -quiet
